Go AST Inspector: standalone Go source AST extraction/visualization; single-HTML distribution. Stack: TypeScript 5.x strict, Svelte 5.x runes, Vite 5.x, Biome 1.x, Go WebAssembly; English UI. Use go/ast, go/parser, go/token; go/parser converts source to AST. Svelte Writable Stores: `astStore`, `parseErrorStore`, `selectedNodeStore`, `expandedNodesStore`. Vite `vite-plugin-singlefile` inlines JS/CSS/WASM.

Before work, read REQUIREMENTS.md and DESIGN.md. REQUIREMENTS.md defines FR-001–FR-006, NFR-001–NFR-006, technology decisions, MVP; DESIGN.md defines architecture (WebAssembly/Application Logic/UI layers), directories, Svelte components, Vite/TypeScript/Biome/Svelte build, data flow, Svelte Store state management. Priority: REQUIREMENTS.md > DESIGN.md. Report contradictions to user and request confirmation. Check both documents first; ask user if undocumented. Do not implement based on independent judgment. Check DESIGN.md build configuration, package.json dependencies, and analyze errors in detail.

Enable strict mode; explicitly type definitions and props; avoid magic numbers (use constants); use `$state`, `$derived`, `$effect`; single-responsibility components; BEM recommended. Global styles: `src/styles/global.css`; component styles in `<style>`. MUST convention: Prohibit redundant comments (no explanation needed for simple operations). SHOULD convention: Write comments where code intent is hard to convey.

MUST convention: Write commit messages in English. MUST convention: Write Pull Request titles and descriptions in English. MUST convention: Add GPG sign to all commits. MUST convention: Add Claude as Co-Author:
🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
Co-Authored-By: Claude <<REDACTED_EMAIL>>
MUST convention: Run `npm run lint` before committing
MUST convention: Run `npm run type-check` before committing
If either command exits with an error, fix the issues before committing
Lint errors: Run `npm run format` to auto-fix formatting issues
Type errors: Fix type mismatches in the reported files
